anomalies.expected: The Core2/CoreS3 PWM1 mapping requires a 0 Ω jumper between /PWM1 and /PWM1_C2; the specification lists R9–R12 as 0 Ω mapping jumpers.

evidence.quote: R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: C6 blocks the DC connection needed for the PWM1 route to bus pin 21, so the specified Core2/CoreS3 channel-1 mapping will not work as intended. Its large capacitance also couples signal transitions between the two GPIO nets.
